campaigns.name: ราคาพิเศษ Suzuki Fronx GL สิงหาคม 2026 (สิทธิ์เต็มแล้ว)
campaigns.notes: Published to 30 September 2026 and capped at 200 cars. Suzuki closed it on 25 August 2026 when the quota was taken, so the campaign ends on the day it really ended, not on the day the calendar said. Motoring articles published in September still carried the 599,000 figure; they are not the authority on whether an offer is still open.
